facts.fact: 自 2009 年起，David 被指与 156 人的失踪有关。
facts.anchor: Since 2009, David had been linked to the disappearances of 156 people.

facts.fact: David 的童年挚友 Erin Morrison 于 2009 年 9 月 19 日（高三开学不到两周）失踪。
facts.anchor: Erin Morrison, David’s childhood best friend, had disappeared on September 19, 2009, not two weeks into their senior year.

facts.fact: 警方因无直接证据未起诉 David；FBI 用了五年才正式签发对他的逮捕令，届时他已藏匿（疑似逃往国外）。
facts.anchor: It would take them five years to officially issue a warrant for David’s arrest, and by that time David had already gone into hiding, presumably fleeing the country.

facts.fact: 2014 年 David 被正式控以 37 名男女（多为女性）的谋杀，这些人都是他在网上结识、随后被诱入其邪教的。
facts.anchor: The thirty-seven men and women (mostly women) whose murders David was officially charged with in 2014 were all people he had met online, then groomed and initiated into the cult he’d invented.

facts.fact: Erin 的母亲 Mary 2015 年在 Dateline 上说「我诅咒女儿遇见那个怪物的那一天」，并当镜头警告会找到 David；Bethany 从官方 NBC 账号看了该上传（其真实 GlobalVill.com 队列在另一标签页播放），该视频获得超过三百万次观看。
facts.anchor: “I curse the day my daughter ever met that monster,” Mary told Dateline in 2015. Bethany watched the upload from the official NBC account while the videos in her actual GlobalVill.com queue played on another unopened tab.

facts.fact: 邪教神话：David 声称只有被称为“the crooked”的特殊人才能进入 Public Access Afterworld、住进自己喜欢的电视节目里。
facts.anchor: Only certain people had the ability to actually do so. Special people whom the cult referred to as “the crooked.”

facts.fact: Bethany 用一个邮箱注册并登录了第一个私密留言板，在 “EVIDENCE” 子论坛看了多条未公开 GlobalVill 视频，随后点进 “CHALLENGE 1” 板块，顶帖写着 “ACQUIRE SCREEN SICKNESS”（要求录屏作证后才给上一级权限）。
facts.anchor: “ACQUIRE SCREEN SICKNESS,” the post at the top of the page read.

facts.fact: 研究数夜后 Bethany 深夜回家，男友 Abel 已经睡着，她爬上床躺到他身边。
facts.anchor: Her boyfriend Abel was still asleep when she got home. She crawled into bed next to him.
